hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; PY=.venv/bin/python; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; OUT=$("$PY" scripts/preflight.py 2>&1) || jq -n --arg r "$OUT" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("preflight failed - push blocked.\n\n" + $r)}}'

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in */frontend/src/*) jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"frontend/src changed, so the shipped bundle in src/SIMPLE_STEPS/frontend_dist/ is now stale. Rebuild before pushing: python -m SIMPLE_STEPS.build_frontend (or scripts/preflight.py --fix)."}}';; esac
